params.name: format
params.description: Output format (data or image)

params.name: identifiers
params.description: Protein identifiers (STRING IDs or gene names), newline-separated (%0d in URL)

params.name: species
params.description: NCBI taxon ID to restrict results to a specific organism. Common values: 9606 (human), 10090 (mouse), 10116 (rat), 7227 (D. melanogaster), 6239 (C. elegans), 4932 (S. cerevisiae), 3702 (A. thaliana), 7955 (zebrafish).

params.name: required_score
params.description: Minimum combined interaction score threshold (0-1000). Higher values return only higher-confidence interactions. Common thresholds: 150 (low), 400 (medium), 700 (high), 900 (highest).

params.name: network_type
params.description: Type of STRING network to use

params.name: network_flavor
params.description: Visual style for network edges

params.name: add_color_nodes
params.description: Number of additional neighborhood proteins to add (shown in color)

params.name: add_white_nodes
params.description: Number of additional neighborhood proteins to add (shown in white)

params.name: hide_node_labels
params.description: Hide protein name labels on network nodes (1=hide, 0=show)

params.name: hide_disconnected_nodes
params.description: Hide proteins with no interactions in the result set (1=hide)

params.name: caller_identity
params.description: A string identifying your application or organization. Strongly recommended; helps STRING admins contact you if there are issues.
